task: Repair SDK packages that cross the Char/String boundary after String.chars() gained Char semantics.
observation: The structured TYPE_MISMATCH diagnostics identified the exact String-only call boundaries in hash.string_to_bytes and regex.compile. Bootstrap source_surface also states that Char and String are distinct and that conversion is explicit, which bounded the repair to SDK conversions instead of compiler changes.
impact: The live compiler facts made it possible to preserve the language contract and target the package code directly.
evidence: packages/hash/src/main.moss:176 TYPE_MISMATCH: String find expects string
packages/regex/src/main.moss:214 TYPE_MISMATCH: argument 6 to function regex__add_tok requires string

resolution.summary: Explicit Char.to_string conversions at String helper boundaries and Char-typed regex comparisons passed hash and regex tests in Native Debug, Native Release, and Fast Debug, plus the all-domain SDK smoke and parity tests against the pinned main behavior.
